rawContent: But then, as #MeToo became a movement, it became obvious the Times would give a LOT of powerful men that same courtesy -- of allowing their misdeeds to be a minor scandal, but that was it.

I remember reading the #MeToo concern trolls -- the voices who right away were telling us to slow down, be cautious, don't DESTROY men's LIVES with this stuff, it could BACKFIRE! But what man's life was actually destroyed by any of this?
